newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks down sharply on settlement, Dow fall.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks down sharply on settlement, Dow fall.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were down sharply in early Friday morning trade, as the settlement of March Nikkei 225 futures and options weighed heavily on the market, brokers said. They said that Wall Street's tumble overnight was also dampening indices.
By 0017 GMT, the Nikkei 225 had fallen 226.99 points, or 1.27 percent, to 17,673.49. Its June futures were down 240 points at 17,560.
Brokers said that before the start of trade, March settlement related sell positions totalled 900,000 for each Nikkei 225 issue and buy positions totalled 400,000.
